steps: Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Tech View in the display switcher.
Set density to Compact and look at the rows, group headers, avatars and progress bars.
Set density to Regular and look again.
Set density to Comfortable and look again.
expected: Step 2: rows are at their shortest (36 px in the design), row text slightly smaller (13 px), avatars smaller and the progress bar shorter and thinner (48 × 4 px), as in the Compact picture; text is never smaller than List's body text.
Step 3: rows 48 px, text 14 px, bar 64 × 6 px, as in the Regular picture.
Step 4: rows tallest (64 px), avatars larger (32 px), and the Progress cell shows the hours (for example "0.8 / 8.0 hrs") under the bar, as in the Comfortable picture.
Steps 2 to 4: the same columns and values show at every density.
